constructors.meaning:
The acquired information-and-copy scope is defined by this unchanged source function: def disposition_scope(t):
    base=['confidential_information']
    if any_phrase(t,['document','file','material','tangible item','property comprising','embodiment']):
        base=['materials_containing',['confidential_information']]
    if any_phrase(t,['all copies','copies thereof','and all copies','copy thereof','copies, electronic']):
        return ['information_union',base,['copies_of',base]]
    return base
constructors.name: information_union

grammar.rationale: Disclosure recipients are nested participant terms whose possessors remain explicit. The contextual party constructor permits a representative definition to be instantiated for the party acting as recipient, while descriptions and information definitions remain non-operative. Permissions may occur directly or as exceptions inside prohibitions. Authorization and purpose exceptions remain bounded exceptions rather than general disclosure permissions.
